description_id: Bundle Video Producer v2.4. Script TikTok dan Reels, hashtag research, sound trend, caption, HyperFrames storyboard + render (Runway primary, Pika fallback). Template pack: short/long/voiceover scripts, shot list, shoot plan, b-roll, description, thumbnail brief. Phase B9 Indonesia-deep: hijab-aware framing, UGC creator brief, TikTok-ID 7s-hook, BI end-card CTA, warung setting. Phase C2 dua playbook flow: script-to-publish dan ugc-collab.

skills.description_id: Hermes generate JSON script (hook + body + CTA + visual scenes + sound + hashtags) pakai LLM customer, lalu validate di edge function untuk pastiin format match schema.
skills.description_en: Hermes generates JSON script using customer's LLM, then validates against locked schema via edge function.

skills.description_id: Susun HyperFrames JSON — storyboard per-scene siap di-feed ke Runway/Sora/CapCut. Scene berisi visual_prompt, motion_hint, duration_sec, audio_cue, transition_to_next. Phase 4-2 menambahkan execution path: hyperframes-render skill yang convert storyboard ini jadi mp4.
skills.description_en: Build HyperFrames JSON storyboard. Pair with hyperframes-render (Phase 4-2) for actual mp4 output.

skills.description_id: Eksekusi storyboard HyperFrames jadi mp4 actual. Per-scene render via Runway (primary, $0.05/s) atau Pika (fallback, $0.02/s) — kamu pasang BYOK key di Hermes .env. Output: array per-scene mp4 URL + stitch recipe. Hermes download tiap scene + jalanin hyperframes-stitch CLI lokal (ffmpeg) untuk merge.
skills.description_en: Execute HyperFrames storyboard to mp4. Per-scene render via Runway (primary) / Pika (fallback). Customer Hermes downloads scenes + runs local ffmpeg stitch.

skills.description_id: Surface sound trend per niche dengan trend stage (emerging / peak / decay) berbasis info publik + customer feedback. Bukan scraping — surface what customer can verify di TikTok/Reels Trending tab sendiri.
skills.description_en: Surface sound trends per niche with trend stage labels.

skills.description_id: Research hashtag mix per niche/topic — emerging tags (volume rendah, upside tinggi), peak tags (saturated), branded tags. Output mix yang fit goal customer.
skills.description_en: Research hashtag mix per niche with stage labels.

skills.description_id: Draft / iterate caption sesuai brand voice + algoritma platform. CTA terselip natural, bukan 'follow us' generik. Length-optimal per platform (TikTok ~150 char, Reels ~125, Shorts ~100).
skills.description_en: Draft platform-optimal captions in brand voice.

skills.description_id: Generate skill atau template baru saat customer minta sesuatu yang belum ada di inventory.
skills.description_en: Generate a new skill or template at runtime when the customer asks for something not in inventory.

skills.description_id: Playbook 8-langkah dari brief video sampai bundle siap publish — intake brief, draft script (pakai template TikTok-ID 7s-hook kalau format TikTok), checkpoint review script, assemble shot list, draft caption, research hashtag, assemble publish-ready bundle, checkpoint approval sebelum publish. Dua gerbang checkpoint, tidak ada publish otomatis.
skills.description_en: 8-step playbook from video brief to publish-ready bundle. Two checkpoint gates — script review and final publish approval.

skills.description_id: Playbook 8-langkah kolaborasi UGC creator Indonesia — intake brand brief, susun shortlist (kriteria Indonesia-relevant / format-fit / budget-fit), draft outreach per creator, susun contract terms pakai template creator-brief-ugc-id, checkpoint creator selection, kirim kickoff brief, review asset hasil produksi, checkpoint final usage approval. Dua gerbang checkpoint, tidak ada outreach atau usage approval otomatis.
skills.description_en: 8-step UGC creator collaboration playbook for Indonesia market. Two checkpoint gates — creator selection and final usage approval.

templates.description_id: Format spec untuk Hermes — instruksi generate JSON script dengan field hook, body, cta, visual_scenes, sound_suggestion, hashtags. Hashtag pattern dan timestamp regex strict.
templates.best_for: Reference yang Hermes baca saat generate script

templates.description_id: JSON schema untuk HyperFrames storyboard — array scenes dengan visual_prompt, motion_hint, duration_sec, audio_cue, transition_to_next.
templates.best_for: Hermes pakai saat generate storyboard, atau export ke Runway/Sora prompt format

templates.description_id: Penjelasan trend stages (emerging / peak / decay) + decision criteria kapan adopt sound.
templates.best_for: Reference framing saat surface sound recommendation

templates.description_id: Strategy mix hashtag — 30/50/20 rule (emerging/peak/branded) sebagai default, plus context-specific variants.
templates.best_for: Default strategy yang dipakai hashtag-research skill

templates.description_id: Caption pattern library — hook openers, CTA variants per platform, length guidelines.
Template skrip short-form (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) — 4 beat: hook 3 detik, setup, payoff, CTA. Per-beat visual cue dan audio cue terpisah biar editor langsung eksekusi tanpa nebak intent.
templates.best_for: Draft skrip 15-90s vertical, batch output harian

templates.description_id: Template skrip long-form YouTube 8-15 menit — hook 30 detik, intro, 3-5 segmen dengan retention check, CTA, outro. Timecode summary auto-generate buat description chapters.
templates.best_for: YouTube horizontal 8-15 menit dengan struktur retention-aware

templates.description_id: Template skrip voiceover-only (product video, explainer, ads) — paragraph chunks, tone note per paragraf, pause cue, dan pronunciation sheet buat term BI/EN yang tricky.
templates.best_for: Product walkthrough, explainer, atau ads tanpa on-cam talent

templates.description_id: Shot list sortable grid — scene, shot type (wide / medium / close / insert), camera move, duration, subject, notes. Termasuk legend shot type, legend camera move, priority marker, dan coverage check 3-shot rule.
templates.best_for: Hari shoot — handoff DP / camera op tanpa briefing ulang

templates.description_id: Full shoot plan multi-lokasi atau multi-hari — locations dengan access notes, shoot order optimized per light dan travel, gear list, crew call sheet, schedule per hari, dan 4 contingency wajib (cuaca, talent, gear, lokasi).
templates.best_for: Production yang lebih dari 1 lokasi atau 1 hari shoot

templates.description_id: B-roll capture brief — subject, narrative purpose, 5-10 shot spesifik dengan komposisi + lighting note per shot, safety captures (room tone, establish, negative space), dan anti-pattern guard.
templates.best_for: B-roll session terpisah dari main shoot — biar editor punya overlay yang punya rencana

templates.description_id: Template description / caption per platform — 4 varian (YouTube long, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, IG Reels). Hook line, ringkasan, chapter timecode untuk long-form, link section, dan hashtag count per platform.
templates.best_for: Publish hari yang sama, lintas platform — caption yang berdiri sendiri tanpa nonton dulu

templates.description_id: Brief desain thumbnail YouTube atau cover Reels / TikTok — main subject + posisi, emosi tunggal, teks overlay maksimal 4 kata, palet 60/30/10, reference image, mobile preview test, dan anti-pattern list (clickbait cliche yang sudah saturated).
templates.best_for: Handoff ke designer atau self-design — thumbnail yang klik-able tanpa visual cliche

templates.description_id: Shot list dengan panduan framing untuk talent berhijab — framing kepala-dada preferred, lighting respects siluet hijab, varian fashion shot untuk segi empat / pashmina / instan / bergo / khimar. Modesty sebagai parameter kreatif, bukan story-line.
templates.best_for: Produksi video dengan talent Muslim Indonesia berhijab — fashion, lifestyle, brand campaign

templates.description_id: Brief UGC creator Indonesia — tone peer-to-peer (bukan talent-for-hire), payment IDR dengan breakdown (script / production / usage rights fee, format titik thousand), usage rights time-bounded (default 6 bulan in-platform + 3 bulan out-of-platform), do's & don'ts kalibrasi Indonesia (agama / politik / disclosure / attribution convention).
templates.best_for: Engage creator UGC Indonesia untuk kolaborasi brand — contract-ready brief sebelum production

templates.description_id: Script TikTok-ID dengan struktur 7-second-hook (kompromi antara 3-detik US convention dan attention pacing Indonesia). Beat: 0-2s hook + 2-7s setup, 7-22s body, 22-27s payoff, 27-30s CTA + brand callout. Register BI casual TikTok-ID, library pilihan kata yang fit / hindari, dan reference creator Indonesia.
templates.best_for: Script TikTok 30-60s untuk audience Indonesia — edukasi-ringan, lifestyle, niche storytelling, promo non-hard-sell

templates.description_id: End card CTA Bahasa Indonesia untuk TikTok / Reels / Shorts — library CTA per intent (Save / Share / Comment / Follow / Link / DM), engagement signal per platform, brand callout convention, dan anti-pattern (no 'Subscribe + Like + Notification Bell' US YouTube convention).
templates.best_for: Penutup 3-5 detik video vertical Indonesia — CTA yang fit ke platform feed-based dan register Indonesia

templates.description_id: Shot list product video di setting otentik warung makan / kafe Indonesia — pilihan jenis warung (warteg / warkop / kafe indie / PKL / warmindo), prop drink cultural-fit (kopi tubruk vs latte), lighting compensation tropical bright + dim indoor, sound strategy (keep-ambient / clean-VO-redub / partial-mix), respect adzan + pemilik warung.
templates.best_for: Product video setting warung Indonesia otentik — bukan studio bertema, lokasi real dengan operasi hidup
